name: Greynode Data Fence's Full Operational Set
description: A slim-cut technical jacket in brushed slate gray with BCI-port access panels at the collar and temples, worn over a signal-isolating turtleneck that creates a localized dead zone for passive wireless reads, slim charcoal trousers with flat-profile data-chip concealment seams, and clean white low-profile sneakers that read as office-casual. The jacket's interior is paneled with Faraday compartments sized for data storage arrays and cold-storage drives. This person could be anyone's IT contractor.
functionality: Signal-isolating turtleneck creates a passive BCI dead zone around the wearer's neck and neural port; Faraday interior panels hold up to 12 data arrays or cold-storage drives undetectable to standard checkpoint sensors.
what_it_says: This person knows things that are not theirs to know, and they'll sell them to whoever pays cleanest.
manufacturer: Greynode Technical Wear (dark market, no storefront)
story_hooks: One of the Faraday compartments contains a drive the fence agreed to hold for forty-eight hours — it's been seventy-two and the client hasn't returned.
The signal-isolating turtleneck is also blocking an emergency medical alert the wearer's implanted cardiac monitor is trying to broadcast.
